title: Use string resources in SettingsScreen composable
name: SettingsScreen
description: Replace hardcoded literals with stringResource() at composition time, and context.getString(...) (using the LocalContext.current already captured as `context`) inside click-handler/callback lambdas that run outside composition -- e.g. the AI-import summary, backup restore result strings, the clipboard label, and the default backup filename. All state, DataStore wiring, and launcher logic is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: 'Dose reminder notifications' row label uses dose_reminder_notifications
Exact-alarm warning text and button use exact_alarm_warning / grant_exact_alarm_access
AI-assisted setup heading/body use the shared ai_assisted_setup heading and settings_ai_setup_body
Copy-prompt button uses copy_setup_prompt; the clipboard label passed to ClipData.newPlainText uses context.getString(R.string.ai_setup_prompt_clip_label)
Paste-JSON field label uses paste_ai_json_label; Import button uses the shared import_button resource
The AI-import result summary uses context.getString(R.string.ai_import_summary, profilesAdded, medicationsAdded) inside performAiImport
Backup heading uses backup_heading; the Collapse/Expand contentDescription uses stringResource(if (backupExpanded) R.string.collapse else R.string.expand)
Backup warning text, Export/Import backup buttons use backup_warning / export_backup / import_backup
exportLauncher.launch(...) uses context.getString(R.string.backup_default_filename) as the default filename
'Backup restored' / 'Could not read the selected file' results use context.getString(R.string.backup_restored) / context.getString(R.string.could_not_read_file)
All DataStore/ViewModel wiring, launcher registration, and dialog logic is otherwise unchanged
